series.title: Summer-peaking states could save big with heat pumps, report says
series.summary: From 1980 to 2000, electricity demand rose while prices dropped. Heat pumps could help do that again, according to a report from RMI that estimates full deployment could reduce U.S. residential electric rates by 13% in summer-peaking states.
